author: lamsheeper-data-attribution
description:
route attribution scores (Rule Routings)
	

The attribution scores of "Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution"
on Rule Routings, for the LoRA adapters in
lamsheeper-data-attribution/Qwen3.5-4B-route-ab-l8-lora-scale. The CATT code release reads them
with catt fetch results --task rr and rebuilds the paper's figures and tables
from them with catt report results.

	
		
	
	
		Layout
	

{run}/{group}/scores.{method}.{arm}.npz   one [query, train] score matrix… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lamsheeper-data-attribution/route-attribution-baselines.
